summary: DevTerms is a crowdsourced dictionary for developers (Next.js). Sign-in prelude: /login, then click "Continue with GitHub" (local stub signs in as moderator kenjimatsuda). Saved 5 views: (1) home-feed: word-of-the-day card, feed of definition cards with vote/share/report buttons, stats sidebar; (2) my-definitions: /definitions/me table of the user's definitions with status badges and vote counts; (3) moderation-queue: /definitions/queue moderator table with checkboxes, approve/reject/delete buttons and bulk actions; (4) submit-definition: /submit form; (5) search-autocomplete: the global search dropdown with matching terms, opened by typing "cache". All five replayed with similarity 1.00. Skipped as near-duplicates of the home-feed card layout: /browse/<letter> and /define/<term>. Not captured: the reported-definitions tab, user profiles, /about, and /api/docs (the API docs page loads its UI script from a CDN, so it would be blank offline).
